title: Existence of the module composition comparisons
statement: Let $u:Y\to X$ and $v:Z\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and, for a scheme $T$, $\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$ the category of sheaves of $\Lambda_T$-modules on the small etale site $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For $w\in\{u,v,u\circ v\}$ let $w^{-1}$ and $w_*$ be the inverse and direct images of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact] (on underlying abelian sheaves the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and the direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] of abelian sheaves). Let $d_{u,v}:(u\circ v)_*\xrightarrow{\sim}u_*\circ v_*$ and $c_{u,v}:v^{-1}\circ u^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}(u\circ v)^{-1}$ be the isomorphisms of functors on abelian sheaves of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] (1), (2). Then: (1) for every $F\in\Mod(Z_{\Et},\Lambda)$ the morphism $d_{u,v,F}:(u\circ v)_*F\to u_*v_*F$ is $\Lambda_X$-linear for the module structures of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]; (2) for every $G\in\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ the morphism $c_{u,v,G}:v^{-1}u^{-1}G\to(u\circ v)^{-1}G$ is $\Lambda_Z$-linear for the module structures of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact] (that of $v^{-1}u^{-1}G$ obtained by applying the module inverse image twice). Hence $d_{u,v}$ and $c_{u,v}$ are isomorphisms of functors $\Mod(Z_{\Et},\Lambda)\to\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)\to\Mod(Z_{\Et},\Lambda)$ whose underlying morphisms of abelian sheaves are those of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. The inverse-image functors may be any lifts equipped with the specified forgetful isomorphisms e_u, e_v, e_uv and module adjunctions a_u, a_v, a_uv whose hom-equivalences agree with the abelian ones after these isomorphisms. The comparisons satisfy, for each module sheaf G on X, (a_u.comp a_v).unit_G followed by the direct-image composite applied to c_G = (a_uv).unit_G followed by d at (L_uv G); explicitly, in Lean composition order, (aU.comp aV).unit.app G ≫ (PV ⋙ PU).map (c.hom.app G) = aUV.unit.app G ≫ d.hom.app (LUV.obj G). No uniqueness assertion is included.

proof.text: The composite module hom-equivalence is compatible with forgetting: expand Adjunction.comp_homEquiv, use the two assumed hom-equivalence equations, and use homEquiv_naturality_left for the abelian adjunction along v. The assumed hom-equivalence equation for u composed with v, applied to the identity of LUV(G), also identifies the module unit after applying eUV with the abelian unit. Precompose the proposed underlying comparison equation with the inverse of the composite forgetful comparison and apply the injective abelian composite hom-equivalence. The module mate equation, the sectionwise description of d, naturality of the abelian direct-image comparison, and the preceding unit identity reduce it to unit_conjugateEquiv_symm for the abelian adjunctions. By the definition of Etale.upperStarComp this is the desired abelian inverse-image comparison. Both comparisons are natural isomorphisms by their constructors, so no separate inverse-linearity or naturality argument is needed.
